scope: Fresh Windows Vulkan captures delivered through MCP and interpreted by official agent CLIs

platforms.codex: Linux CLI launching Windows Poima through WSL interoperability
platforms.claude: Windows native CLI and Windows Poima

method: Author a temporary world with a camera and two neutrally named box entities. Randomly choose distinct dominant RGB colors without disclosing them in the prompt.
Permit only schema discovery and one world.capture MCP call with image option; reject traces containing entity queries, file reads or other tool activity.
Verify native hardware capture receipt, source BMP hash, dimensions and actual PNG image block in each agent event stream.
Compare final left/right color answer against independently measured dominant-color pixel masks in the source BMP.

verification.negative_check: Removing the image block rejects the trace.

limits: One simple image per client on NVIDIA RTX 4070 Laptop GPU; no broad accuracy or reliability claim.
Unscaled 640x400 image path; reduced image interpretation not exercised here.
Receipt reports zero NVRHI errors; this client exercise did not explicitly enable Vulkan validation layers.
Independent fixture selection and answer verification are test tooling, not engine intelligence.
No raw account data or provider transcripts are published.
